messages:
Maya: dropping a short thread with the follow-ups from the reliability segment of today’s all-hands. I captured RCAs, timelines, and action owners. Please add corrections or missing owners.

Jordan: thanks — this is great. can we explicitly call out the customer-facing notification plan for Dedicated customers? people asked during Q&A.

Maya: good call. adding a notification action item below. tentative plan is an email + status page update after the canary looks good.

Leo: quick context: the root cause for the morning 503 spike was a router config race when scaling up a control-plane shard. RCA draft here: https://redwood-internal/rca/INC-2026-router-race (internal). TL;DR: config push + transient schema mismatch -> dropped connections.

Sam: is the fix backwards-compatible? i.e., can we roll forward without rolling back running workloads?

Leo: yes — the patch adds a short-lived compatibility check and a retry loop. rollout plan in the RCA. canary -> gradated -> full. we expect no downtime.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: router-fix-canary -> prod at 2026-04-28T14:00Z (build-ff12ab).

Emily: FYI I’ll own the SLI/dashboard updates. will add a temporary alert for 5xx rate spikes and annotate the query with the incident tag.

Ana: I’ll add the integration test that caught the schema mismatch in premerge. owner: Ana, due 2026-05-07.

Jordan: I’ll coordinate the Dedicated customer notifications and provide copy for the status page. owner: Jordan, due 2026-04-30.

Maya: consolidating actions (please reply to claim or update dates):
```
- RCA: https://redwood-internal/rca/INC-2026-router-race (Leo) — publish final by 2026-04-29
- Canary rollout: Leo + Runtime (Leo) — canary start 2026-04-28 14:00Z, gradate if no regressions
- SLI/alerts: Emily — add 5xx alert + dashboard note by 2026-04-30
- E2E test: Ana — add premerge test for config schema mismatch by 2026-05-07
- Dedicated customer comms: Jordan — status page + email draft by 2026-04-30
- Post-deploy verification: Ops oncall + Runtime (Sam) — run smoke suite and KV-cache checks within 1 hour of gradation
- Follow-up retro + exec summary: Maya — collate notes and publish to docs by 2026-05-04
```

Sam: adding a small ask from the Q&A — can we get the SLA impact numbers in the exec summary? even ballpark token-cost / latency impact.

Maya: yes — I’ll include a short table in the exec summary.

Jordan: quick note — if anyone needs the customer list for Dedicated alerts ping me and I’ll share the subset.

Emily: after the canary I’ll post the alert hits here so leadership can see numbers.

Ana: claimed the e2e task. will post PR link when ready.

Maya: thanks all. if there are no objections I’ll close the thread tomorrow and move the final action list into the reliability runbook. :thumbsup:

Leo: no objections from me.

ops-bot: reminder: create follow-up ticket in "reliability-action-tracker" when RCA is published.
